_about: Treatment catalogue (spec 4 REQ-002, 5.3). OWNED BY THE CLINICAL LEAD. The treatments a clinician can choose when drafting an episode: code system, code, display name, and which adherence question applies (spec 6.1 Q7). Empty until the clinical lead fills it; development uses obviously synthetic placeholders instead (packages/config/src/synthetic.ts), which staging and production refuse.
